teaser.en: On a dewy morning walk, a branch of this plant was used to knock the wet off the grass ahead.
teaser.sw: Katika matembezi ya asubuhi yenye umande, tawi la mmea huu lilitumiwa kupiga nyasi zilizo mbele ili kuondoa unyevu.
teaser.dg: Atu achiphiya ligundzu na nyasi zina manena, panda ya mmea uhu yahumirwa kupiga nyasi za mbere ili kuusa manena.

summary.en: *Chikuta manena* is a climbing shrub whose name records an everyday habit: people beat the grass with its branches to knock off the morning dew.
summary.sw: *Chikuta manena* ni kichaka kinachopanda ambacho jina lake linahifadhi desturi ya kila siku: watu hupiga nyasi kwa matawi yake ili kukung'uta umande wa asubuhi.
summary.dg: *Chikuta manena* ni chitsaka chinachokpwera, ambacho dzinare rinaonyesa dzambo ra chila siku: atu nkupiga nyasi kpwa pandaze ili kuusa manena ga ligundzu.

about.en: *Rourea orientalis* is a scrambling or climbing shrub with pinnate leaves of several pairs of leaflets. Its new growth is often reddish. Its small, fragrant flowers grow in clusters, and its fruits are small pods that split to show a seed with a fleshy coat.
about.sw: *Rourea orientalis* ni kichaka kinachotambaa au kupanda, chenye majani yaliyogawanyika kuwa jozi kadhaa za vijani. Machipukizi yake mapya mara nyingi huwa na rangi nyekundu. Maua yake madogo yenye harufu nzuri huota katika vishada, na matunda yake ni maganda madogo yanayopasuka na kuonyesha mbegu yenye ganda lenye nyama.
about.dg: *Rourea orientalis* ni chitsaka chinachoambala au chinachokpwera dzulu ya mimea yanjina, chenye makodza ganayoganyika dza nyoya kpwa jozi chache za makodza madide. Makodza maphya mara nyinji ni ga kundu chidide. Maruwage madide genye arufu nono ganamera kpwa mafungu, na matundage ni makakaya madide ganayoahuka na kuonyesa tembe yenye chifwiniko cha nyama.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and thicket in East Africa.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu na vichaka vizito vya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Chinamera kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki.

uses.en: Pakia records that its branches are used to beat the grass along a path, to clear off the dew before walking through on morning errands.
uses.sw: Pakia ameandika kwamba matawi yake hutumika kupiga nyasi kando ya njia, ili kuondoa umande kabla ya kupita katika shughuli za asubuhi.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala pandaze nkuhumirwa kupiga nyasi kanda-kanda ya njira, ili kuusa manena kabla ya kutsupa phapho mutu achiphiya kazi za ligundzu.

names.en: *Chikuta manena* means 'clears the dew': its branches are used to hit (*kuta*) the grass and knock off the dew (*manena*). A different plant, *Synaptolepis kirkii*, is called *mkuta manena*. No Swahili or English name has been recorded.
names.sw: *Chikuta manena* maana yake ni 'kinachoondoa umande': matawi yake hutumika kupiga (*kuta*) nyasi na kukung'uta umande (*manena*). Mmea tofauti, *Synaptolepis kirkii*, huitwa *mkuta manena*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: *Chikuta manena* manage ni 'chinachousa manena': pandaze nkuhumirwa kupiga (*kuta*) nyasi na kuusa manena (*manena*). Mmea wanjina, *Synaptolepis kirkii*, unaihwa *mkuta manena*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.

reason.en: Synaptolepis, with almost the same name
reason.sw: Synaptolepis, yenye jina karibu sawa kabisa
reason.dg: *Synaptolepis*, wenye dzina phephi sawa na hiri

reason.dg: Mmea wanjina uriohewa dzina kula kpwa matumizi ga nyumbani

reason.dg: Uriohewa dzina kula kpwa matumizi ga chila siku
